node_notes.button: This is the active-high user-button input connected to PA0. The adapter samples it with LL_GPIO_IsInputPinSet and board_button_is_pressed, as configured in firmware/configs/app_config.h and firmware/bsp/board.h.
node_notes.systick: The 1 ms SysTick interrupt advances the adapter's monotonic millisecond count. Core/Src/main.c configures the tick and Core/Src/stm32f4xx_it.c forwards it to the board adapter.
node_notes.uart: USART2 provides the console transmit path on PA2, configured for 115200 baud and TX-only operation. firmware/platforms/stm32/console_stm32.c writes bytes with LL_USART_TransmitData8.
node_notes.console: This backend routes stdout and stderr to USART2 transmit and configures the TX alternate function on PA2. Its initialization and _write transport are implemented in firmware/platforms/stm32/console_stm32.c.
node_notes.irq: The Cube SysTick handler forwards each tick to the STM32 board adapter. Core/Src/stm32f4xx_it.c calls board_io_stm32_systick_isr.
node_notes.led: This is the active-high indicator LED output connected to PD12. The application toggles it through board_io_led_toggle, implemented with LL_GPIO_TogglePin in firmware/platforms/stm32/board_io_stm32.c.
node_notes.boardio: This STM32 adapter implements the board I/O calls using LL GPIO operations and a SysTick-backed millisecond counter. It reads PA0 and toggles PD12 in firmware/platforms/stm32/board_io_stm32.c.
node_notes.app: This application runs the cooperative LED blink and button debounce logic. It uses the board I/O contract and logs startup and button transitions, as shown in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.logger: The logger macros format application status messages through printf. LOGI is used for startup and accepted button-state changes in firmware/utils/logger/logger.h and firmware/app/app.c.

sequence.title: Sequence Diagram
sequence.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Boot
  participant App
  participant BoardIO as STM32 board I/O
  participant Button as PA0 user button
  participant LED as PD12 indicator LED
  participant SysTick
  participant Logger
  participant Console as USART2 console
  Boot->>App: app_start
  App->>BoardIO: board_io_init
  App->>Console: console_init
  App->>Logger: LOGI bring-up started
  Logger->>Console: printf output via _write
  Console->>Console: Configure USART2 TX on PA2
  loop Foreground iterations; LED interval 200 ms
    SysTick-->>BoardIO: Increment millisecond counter
    App->>BoardIO: Read milliseconds and button state
    BoardIO->>Button: LL_GPIO_IsInputPinSet on PA0
    Button-->>BoardIO: Electrical input level
    alt 200 ms elapsed
      App->>BoardIO: board_io_led_toggle
      BoardIO->>LED: LL_GPIO_TogglePin on PD12
    else LED interval not elapsed
      App->>App: Keep LED state
    end
    alt Candidate button state changed
      App->>App: Record candidate and start debounce interval
    else Candidate unchanged
      alt Candidate stable for 20 ms and differs from stable state
        App->>Logger: LOGI pressed or released
        Logger->>Console: printf output via _write
      else Debounce interval not satisfied
        App->>App: Keep stable button state
      end
    end
    App->>BoardIO: board_io_wait_for_interrupt
  end
